steps.what: Assemble proposals and reports from stored figures.
Present and explain the findings to the clients.
Record the questions the clients raised about the findings.

tasks.design: Proposals and reports are assembled in {DOCS} from figures already stored. The manager presents and explains the findings to the clients. A figure with no id is not assembled. The pack does not present itself.
tasks.previous_blocker: The slide pack was rebuilt the morning of the client meeting from the same stored figures.
tasks.enabler_now: Figures already stored can be assembled before the manager presents.
tasks.still_hard: A question the pack does not anticipate, which is why the manager is in the room.
tasks.human_edge: The manager can tell which finding the client has not accepted, even when the figure is right.
tasks.altitude: Stored figures can be assembled. The manager still presents and explains the findings.

reach.task: Assemble the stored figures, and still leave the client explanation here.
reach.learn: The pack can be shared. The presentation stays here.

evidence.claim: A proposal or report can be assembled from figures already stored. The pack cannot present or explain the findings.
The manager speaks to the client. The pack does not answer a question the figures do not contain.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An architectural and engineering manager in a mid-size European firm. A list does not approve a design, place a person, or issue a contract.
Fields: Figure id, produced by the calculation already stored. A figure with no id is not assembled. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the engineering manager finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the report file the firm already keeps. Do not present from an unstored figure.
unknowns: Which meetings the manager must attend.
research_questions: What share of packs are assembled from stored figures?
Which findings are explained without a stored figure?

already_counted.description: The manager still presents the findings.
The manager still records the questions.

incremental.description: The manager adds a figure the file did not hold.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is assembling proposals and reports from figures already stored. It disappears when the figure is missing and the manager adds it. Presenting and explaining the findings stays with the manager.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List stored project specifications for the procedure.
Confer with management, production, and marketing staff.
Discuss and record the procedure the staff accepted.

tasks.design: Project specifications already stored for the procedure are listed from {PROJECT}. The manager confers with management, production, and marketing staff. A procedure with no id is not listed. The list does not hold the discussion.
tasks.previous_blocker: The specification was restated at the start of every staff conference.
tasks.enabler_now: A stored specification can be listed before the conference.
tasks.still_hard: A production constraint the specification does not mention.
tasks.human_edge: The manager can hear production and marketing disagree and decide which constraint holds.
tasks.altitude: Stored specifications can be listed. The manager still confers with staff and still records the procedure they accept.

reach.task: List the stored specification, and still hold the staff conference in the room.
reach.learn: The list can be shared. The conference stays here.

evidence.claim: A project specification already stored for a procedure can be listed. The list cannot confer with staff.
The manager holds the discussion. The list stores no score of a staff member.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An architectural and engineering manager in a mid-size European firm. A list does not approve a design, place a person, or issue a contract.

Fields: Procedure id and specification id, produced by the project file. A procedure with no id is not listed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the engineering manager finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the project file the firm already keeps. Do not store a score of who spoke.
unknowns: Which procedures already have a specification.
Which conferences must include production and marketing.
research_questions: What share of conferences start from a stored specification?
Which procedures are settled only in the room?

already_counted.description: The manager still confers with staff.
The manager still records the procedure.

incremental.description: The manager writes a specification the file did not hold.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is listing project specifications already stored for the procedure. It disappears when the specification is missing and the manager writes it. Conferring with staff stays with the manager.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List stored resource needs and the technology already named.
Assess feasibility by analyzing technology, resource needs, and market demand.
Record the project feasibility judgement the manager accepts.

tasks.design: Resource needs already stored, and the technology already named, are listed from the {ERP}. The manager assesses feasibility, including market demand. A project with no resource id is not listed. The list does not judge feasibility.
tasks.previous_blocker: Resource needs were retyped from the last project before anyone looked at demand.
tasks.enabler_now: A stored resource need can be listed before the manager assesses demand.
tasks.still_hard: A market the stored needs do not describe.
tasks.human_edge: The manager can see enough resource and still no buyer.
tasks.altitude: Stored resource needs can be listed. The manager still assesses technology and market demand.

reach.task: List the stored resource need, and still leave the market judgement here.
reach.learn: The need can be listed. The feasibility stays here.

evidence.claim: A resource need already stored, and a technology already named, can be listed. The list cannot assess market demand.
The manager judges feasibility. A resource list does not commit the firm to the project.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An architectural and engineering manager in a mid-size European firm. A list does not approve a design, place a person, or issue a contract.

Fields: Project id and resource id, produced by the planning file. A project with no resource id is not listed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the engineering manager finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the planning file the firm already keeps. Do not treat a list as a go decision.
unknowns: Which projects already have stored resource needs.
Which markets have no stored demand figure.
research_questions: What share of assessments start from a stored resource need?
Which projects are refused despite a complete list?

already_counted.description: The manager still records the judgement.

incremental.description: The manager adds a resource need the file did not hold.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is listing resource needs already stored and technologies already named. It disappears when the need is missing and the manager adds it. Assessing feasibility stays with the manager.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Compare cost estimates with the stored contract rates.
Review, recommend, or approve the contracts.
Record the accepted estimate against the contract.

tasks.design: Cost estimates are compared in the {ERP} with contract rates already stored. The manager reviews, recommends, or approves the contract. The accepted estimate is recorded in {DOCS} only for that version. A missing rate stops the comparison. The comparison does not approve the contract.
tasks.previous_blocker: Estimates were checked against a rate card that was not the one on the contract.
tasks.enabler_now: A stored contract rate can be compared before the manager recommends.
tasks.still_hard: An estimate that matches the rate and still buys the wrong scope.
tasks.human_edge: The manager can match every rate and still refuse the contract.
tasks.altitude: Stored rates can be compared. The manager still recommends or approves the contract, and only that version is recorded.

reach.task: Compare a stored rate, and still leave the contract recommendation here.
reach.learn: The comparison can be shared. The approval stays here.

evidence.claim: A cost estimate can be compared with a contract rate already stored. The comparison cannot recommend or approve the contract.
The estimate is recorded only for the version the manager accepted. A later change is not that version.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An architectural and engineering manager in a mid-size European firm. A list does not approve a design, place a person, or issue a contract.

Fields: Estimate id and rate id, produced by the contract file. An estimate with no rate is not compared. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the engineering manager finishes it by hand.
Native check: Record into the contract file the firm already keeps. Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the engineering manager.
unknowns: Who else must approve above a threshold.
research_questions: What share of estimates have a stored rate?
Which contracts are refused after the rates match?

already_counted.description: The manager still reviews and recommends the contract.

incremental.description: The manager prices an estimate the rate file did not hold.

approvals.approved_version: estimate version and the contract ids it cites

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is comparing cost estimates with stored contract rates, and recording only the accepted version. It disappears when the rate is missing and the manager prices it. Recommending the contract stays with the manager.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The manager still presents to the client, still confers with staff, and still judges feasibility. A stored figure can be assembled first. A contract is recorded only after the manager recommends it.
reach: Regulatory affairs managers explain a finding themselves, and this job learns a stored figure is not the presentation.
Wind energy development managers compare a cost with a stored rate and still decide the contract.
skills_to_grow: Present the findings to the client in person.
Recommend the contract before it is recorded.
role.ambitious_version: Stored figures and stored rates are ready first, and the client presentation, the staff conference, and the contract recommendation stay with the manager.
